title: County dimension of DBA costs, per jurisdiction
description: DRAFT - the starting contract, expected to change while the pilot runs. Records the county dimension of DBA costs for the scoped set of jurisdictions where filing is county/split or publication is required: a verified fee range, up to three example counties, and a publication cost note. Publication requirements stay authoritative in dba-rules; this namespace is authoritative for county fee figures and publication costs.

applies.description: Whether this jurisdiction has a county dimension. false is only used inside the scoped set, for a jurisdiction whose county costs turned out not to vary; null means not yet researched.

feeRangeUsd.description: The range the official pages actually show, or the range spanned by the verified examples. Never an average, never a guess.

publicationCostNote.description: One short sentence on publication cost where publication is required. The requirement itself stays authoritative in dba-rules.

examples.description: Verified county examples, capped at three per jurisdiction by design.

note.description: Anything the fields cannot carry without lying.

notes.description: Anything the record cannot carry without lying: scope calls, excluded counties, boundary cases.

needsReview.description: What is missing and what would settle it.

type.description: Source class, for deriving record confidence mechanically. null where none of the classes fits.

lastVerified.description: The date the cited pages were retrieved and every quoted passage was mechanically confirmed to occur in them.

quote.description: One contiguous verbatim passage, copied from the page as retrieved, artefacts included. Never assembled across an ellipsis, never taken from a search snippet, never tidied.

supports.description: Which value in the enclosing object this passage grounds, by field name (feeRangeUsd, examples, publicationCostNote, ...). A record carrying several passages is only honest if each one says what it is evidence for.
